content.user_title: Manage Lark Sheets from AI Assistants
content.value_statement: Teams need reliable spreadsheet actions without memorizing Lark CLI syntax. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Lark Sheets tasks.
actual_capabilities: Create a Lark spreadsheet with optional headers and initial rows.
Read selected ranges and flatten rich text cells into plain text.
Write or append two-dimensional row data to a known sheet.
Find text or regex matches inside a specified worksheet range.
Export sheets as xlsx or csv, with optional local download.
Inspect spreadsheet metadata, sheet IDs, titles, and dimensions.
limitations: Requires lark-cli and valid Lark authentication before any operation.
Works on known spreadsheet URLs or tokens, not broad Drive discovery.
Write, append, create, and export actions can change or copy user data.
Large reads are truncated by the shortcut default to reduce output size.

use_cases.title: Update Warehouse Revenue Sheets
use_cases.description: Append monthly warehouse figures, confirm write ranges, and export reports for review.

use_cases.title: Inspect Sheet Structure
use_cases.description: List sheet IDs and read focused ranges before preparing analysis or cleanup tasks.

use_cases.title: Create Team Trackers
use_cases.description: Create a shared spreadsheet with headers and starter rows for project tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Read A Range
prompt_templates.prompt: Use lark-sheets to read cells A1:H20 from this Lark Sheet URL. Show the values in a concise table.

prompt_templates.title: Append Rows Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Append these approved rows to the known sheet. Use dry run first, then ask before writing the final data.

prompt_templates.title: Find Matching Cells
prompt_templates.prompt: Search this spreadsheet for matching customer names in the selected sheet. Include sheet ID, matched cells, and nearby context.

prompt_templates.title: Create And Seed A Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Lark Sheet for monthly revenue, add these headers and starter rows, then report the URL and permission status.

output_examples.input: Read the first 20 rows from my Lark Sheet.
output_examples.output: A concise table of the requested rows, plus the exact sheet range and any truncation notice.

output_examples.input: Create a revenue tracker with headers and one starter row.
output_examples.output: The new spreadsheet title, link, token summary, and a clear note about access permission results.
The saved file name and size, or the export file token when no output path is provided.

best_practices: Confirm user intent before create, write, append, export, or permission changes.
Use dry-run mode when available before sending write or export requests.
Read sheet info first when the sheet ID or range is unknown.
anti_patterns: Using this skill to search all Drive files by title; use Lark docs search first.
Writing to a broad range without reading or confirming the target worksheet.
Assuming a wiki token is the spreadsheet token without resolving the object first.

faq.question: Can this skill find spreadsheets by name?
faq.answer: No. It searches inside a known spreadsheet. Use Lark docs search to locate files first.

faq.question: Does it require authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. lark-cli must be installed and authenticated with permissions for the target spreadsheet.

faq.question: Can it modify existing data?
faq.answer: Yes. Write and append operations can change spreadsheet cells, so confirmation is required.

faq.question: What formats can it export?
faq.answer: It supports xlsx and csv through the documented export shortcut.

faq.question: Can it use spreadsheet URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. It accepts supported Lark Sheet URLs or spreadsheet tokens.

faq.question: How does it handle large reads?
faq.answer: The read shortcut limits returned rows by default and reports when output is truncated.
